description: This is an overhaul mod for the rather dull and boring ruined portals in Minecraft Java Fabric 1.21.11 This serves as my submission to Hackcraft!

mods.name: Ruined Portal Overhaul
mods.description:
Ruined Portal Overhaul turns every overworld ruined portal into a Procedural Portal Dungeon: a radius-136 corrupted scar with three deterministic variants, a protected pit hub, a deep connected nether cave system, lava runs, ritual pedestals, red-storm atmosphere and frequent loot.

Approaching the frame wakes the Gold Tribute Raid, a proximity-triggered five-wave encounter with Piglin-Illager hybrids, difficulty- and config-scaled waves, boss-bar progress, ring-based spawns, custom sounds, red thunder, advancements and post-raid spawn suppression.

Victory lights the portal, spawns the boss chest and summons the Exiled Piglin Trader. Endgame progression runs through the Ghast Tear Necklace, Nether Conduit upgrades, the Nether Crystal ritual and an overworld Nether Dragon boss that drops a placeable Nether Dragon Egg, Corrupted Netherite, the Portal Shard and Nether Tide music, with optional Patchouli/REI integration.
